title: Openstax_workshop
summary: A Jupyter notebook workshop exploring synthetic data generation to reproduce a research paper's sample size and validate distributional fit. It uses a custom NonParamGaussianCopulaSynthesizer class, named after and modeled on SDV's GaussianCopula synthesizer concept, though its internal implementation is not visible in the harvested evidence.
needs: Cannot verify whether src.non_parametric.NonParamGaussianCopulaSynthesizer wraps or imports the actual copulas/sdv package internally, or is an independent reimplementation; no README or dependency file evidence provided.
